base: Create ONE production sprite sheet of EXACTLY 80 distinct generic alternate-history task icons for a strategy-game development desktop tool. 10 columns x 8 rows equal square cells, request canvas 1600x1280. Every icon entirely inside its cell, centered, generous TRANSPARENT padding minimum 16 percent on all sides; artwork no larger than 68 percent of cell. Entire background truly transparent, no backgrounds/backplates, grid, labels or cell numbers. Cohesive hand-painted strategy-game inventory symbols, antiqued copper and brass, cream highlights, muted olive, dark outlines for readability at 32px, bold simple recognizable silhouettes, minimal microdetail. No political party insignia, no lettering, no watermark. Distinguish lightning bolt (energy symbol) from electricity (plug) and distinguish generic propeller airplane from bomber and jet. Subjects MUST appear in exact row-major order. Row 1: snowflake; sewing needle with thread; sword; pistol gun; jagged lightning bolt; electricity plug with short cable; tank; propeller airplane; motorbike; royal crown. Row 2: steel infantry helmet; gas mask; military medal; battle standard banner; laurel wreath; broken crown; ballot box; protest placard; raised fist; signed treaty scroll. Row 3: atom symbol; laboratory flask; microscope; DNA double helix; medical syringe; test tube rack; biohazard symbol; radiation symbol; horseshoe magnet; satellite. Row 4: zeppelin airship; helicopter; heavy bomber airplane; jet fighter; battleship; submarine; aircraft carrier; field artillery cannon; guided missile; armored car. Row 5: oil derrick; coal lumps; mining pickaxe; steel ingots; wind turbine; electricity transmission pylon; hydroelectric dam; grain silo; steam locomotive; industrial smokestacks. Row 6: wheat sheaf; bread loaf; ration tin; supply crate; coin stack; bank building; rising economy bar chart; printing press; newspaper; refugee suitcase. Row 7: desert dunes; erupting volcano; iceberg; rain cloud; tornado; sun; crescent moon; solar eclipse; comet; quartz crystals. Row 8: border checkpoint gate; watchtower; fortress wall; concrete bunker; barbed wire coil; steel bridge; ship steering wheel; military supply truck; parachute; burning torch. All 80 present exactly once. Not a scene or poster. Precise uniform 10x8 atlas.
